title: Business Development Executive - Arabic Speaker
description:
About Us

We are a premier UK-based lettings and property management company operating within a global cross-border integrated service group. Our core expertise spans property investment, asset management, and high-end cross-border solutions.

With a strong footprint across major UK hubs and an expanding global network, we provide seamless, end-to-end property solutions for international High-Net-Worth (HNW) families, investors, and overseas students. As part of our regional expansion, we are actively scaling our operations in Manchester to connect with landlords, real estate investors, and strategic partners across the MENA region (Middle East & North Africa).

Job Overview

We are seeking a proactive, target-driven Business Development Executive to join our Manchester team.

In this role, you will be the key driver behind establishing strategic B2 B partnerships across the MENA region and within the UK's Middle Eastern business community. Your primary focus will be connecting with overseas real estate agencies, family offices, wealth managers, and property consultancies to generate high-value landlord leads, integrate client portfolios, and promote our UK lettings and management services (spanning Manchester, North West England, and London).

Key Responsibilities
- B2 B Partner Acquisition: Source and establish strong relationships with MENA-based real estate agencies, brokers, and property consultancies that market UK real estate to Gulf and North African investors.
- Landlord Lead Generation: Pitch our full-suite UK lettings and property management services to international Middle Eastern landlords, HNW families, and institutional portfolio owners.
- Strategic Alliances: Build referral pipelines with UK-MENA cross-border service providers, including law firms, tax consultancies, private wealth managers, and relocation/education agencies.
- Co-Marketing & Events: Plan and execute targeted digital webinars and offline networking events (in Manchester, London, and key MENA cities) to boost brand awareness among international property investors.
- Inventory & Asset Integration: Partner with regional developers, build-to-rent (BTR) operators, and property owners to secure premium rental inventory for international clients.
- Relationship Management: Serve as the primary account manager for key MENA partners, managing performance, optimizing referral structures, and ensuring seamless client onboarding.
- Market Insights: Track UK real estate market trends (especially Manchester and North West developments) and competitor strategies within the MENA investment corridor.

Essential Requirements
- Language Skills: Native or business-fluent Arabic and business-fluent English (written and spoken) capable of high-level business negotiations.
- Experience: Open to ambitious Graduates (with business, real estate, or marketing degrees) or candidates with 1-2 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Client Relationship Management (UK or MENA Real Estate experience is a strong plus).
- Work Authorization: Must possess valid UK full-time right to work (e.g., Graduate Visa, Skilled Worker Visa, ILR, or British Citizenship). Note: No visa sponsorship provided at this time.
- Network & Market Knowledge: Basic understanding of the UK residential property market (Manchester/North West market knowledge is ideal); familiarity with Middle Eastern investor expectations and cultural nuances.
- Core Competencies: Self-starter, target-driven, and highly proficient in networking, cold outreach, and managing multi-channel B2 B pipelines.

What We Offer
- Competitive Package: Attractive base salary + uncapped performance bonuses + referral commissions + annual profit share.
- Career Growth: Clear promotion pathway, structured professional development, and exposure to a global cross-border property network.
- Comprehensive Benefits:
- 25 days paid annual leave + UK Bank Holidays
- Statutory Pension Scheme
- Paid sick leave, maternity, and paternity leave
- Perks & Culture:
- Central Manchester office location with a collaborative, multicultural team.
- Travel expense coverage for work-related UK and international business trips.
- In-depth training on cross-border property transactions and negotiation.

Language:
- native Arabic (required)

Willingness to travel:
- 50% (preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Founding sales consultant
description:
Founding sales consultant £40,000 - £60,000 per annum, OTE, uncapped

Remote. UK-wide. Permanent, full-time

The job

You will be our first salesperson.

We help UK company directors close their companies. Some of them are fine financially and just want it done properly. Others owe money they cannot pay, and they are worried about what that means for them personally - their home, their savings, whether they have done something wrong.

Your job is to pick up the phone, work out which of those two you are talking to, and help them get to the right answer. You look after everyone you speak to, from the first call through to them signing with us. Nobody takes over halfway.

Both things you will sell are a type of voluntary liquidation - one for companies that can pay what they owe, one for companies that cannot.

What the day looks like
- You are on the phone. People who call us, people who started a chat and went quiet, and people nobody has got round to yet. We have automated most written communication, but you pick things up when they need a real person.
- Most decisions happen across one to three conversations. Usually quickly, because a creditor is chasing them or a letter has arrived. There is no long buying process and usually only one director you need to guide.
- You close. You give them the price, you answer the hard questions, you get it signed. Nothing gets passed up to someone more senior.
- You help us get better at selling. We have a way of doing this that works, and you will be the person who improves it.

Who this is for
- You have sold to someone who was worried. Probate, personal insolvency, debt advice, mortgage protection. If you have been on the phone with someone under real pressure and your job was to stay calm and be straight with them, that is the experience that counts.
- You like being on the phone. That is most of the day, every day.
- You have worked on your own before. No sales floor, nobody at the next desk, nobody looking over your shoulder.
- You would rather help decide how something works than be handed a finished process.

You do not need to know anything about insolvency. You'll get training, resources, and a daily slot with me for anything you are unsure about.

What we offer
- £40,000 salary, and £60,000 if you hit your numbers. There is no cap on it. You earn commission on every deal you close, and your first three months are paid at target while you are building up from nothing.
- Share options, so you own a piece of what you help build.
- Work from anywhere in the UK.
- Sensible hours. We do not expect you online at ten at night.
- The first sales job here, which is not something you can get at a company that already has a sales team.

About us

We founded Closeday to change how companies are closed. Completely new software, powered by AI. Licensed insolvency practitioners in-house, regulated by the ICAEW. We are making a solution which is transparent, simple, and fair. We never sell something our customers don't need or surprise them with extra fees.

We are at the point where our growth needs someone besides the founders to have conversations with directors and sell our solutions. That's where you come into the picture.

This is still an early team (fewer than 10), so you will be shaping how we sell in collaboration with a founder. That founder is me, Mikkel. I have been an entrepreneur for 15 years, starting as an engineer, and done everything from product management to marketing and sales. Before Closeday, I founded Capdesk which was acquired by a large Silicon Valley company.

Looking forward to meeting you!

What happens after you apply

The hiring process includes the following steps: CV review, intro call, a roleplay of a customer conversation, and finally a longer conversation with me.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Pickfords is an iconic British brand, moving excellence is our passion and we have been relocating families and businesses locally and across the world for over 350 years.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic individual to join our Move Manager Team, with a passion for customer service and a desire to exceed our clients expectations.

Job Purpose

As a Move Manager, you will be the customer's main point of contact throughout their move, delivering excellent customer service and ensuring every move is managed smoothly from enquiry to completion.

Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will coordinate each move, maintain accurate records, identify sales opportunities and provide a seamless, stress-free experience for every customer.

Key Responsibilities
- Be the customer's dedicated point of contact throughout their moving journey.
- Understand customer needs and deliver an outstanding customer experience.
- Identify opportunities to promote and upsell relevant products and services.
- Process customer documentation accurately and in line with company procedures and legal requirements.
- Manage customer enquiries, quotes, bookings and administration efficiently within agreed timescales.
- Deliver excellent customer service while achieving agreed KPIs and performance targets.
- Resolve customer queries and issues promptly and professionally.
- Build strong working relationships with colleagues and other departments to ensure moves run smoothly.
- Participate in team meetings, briefings and training, sharing ideas and best practice.
- Carry out any other duties appropriate to the role.

Key Performance Areas
- Manage incoming calls and customer enquiries professionally and promptly.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records within the CRM system.
- Maximise enquiry to quote and booking through effective sales and customer service.
- Follow the three-call process to maximise sales opportunities and deliver excellent customer service.
- Process customer payments accurately in line with company procedures.
- Resolve customer queries and complaints efficiently.
- Deliver exceptional customer service that encourages positive feedback, online reviews and recommendations.
- Follow company policies, procedures and compliance standards to ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience
- Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to build rapport with customers and colleagues.
- Strong customer focus with a passion for delivering outstanding service.
- Positive, enthusiastic and self-motivated with a proactive, can-do attitude.
- Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads.
- Flexible and adaptable, responding positively to changing priorities.
- Calm and professional when working under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Results-driven with a commitment to delivering work to a high standard.
- A team player who enjoys collaborating and sharing best practice.
- Motivated to achieve personal and team objectives.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for logistics and relocation services, we would love to hear from you. 'Apply' now to join our dynamic team.
